title: Part-Time Naik & Part-Time Lance Naik (Volunteers)
selection_process: The selection for Meghalaya BWHG Enrollment 2026 involves a Personal Interview conducted at designated centres. No separate intimation regarding the interview will be sent to individual candidates - it is the responsibility of the volunteer to monitor the selected list and interview dates published by the department. || Stage 1:Submission of application in Prescribed Standard Form with all required documents to the respective District Home Guards office or District Training Centre or Deputy Controller of Civil Defence office. || Stage 2:Scrutiny of applications. || Stage 3:Personal Interview atTuraorShillongcentres. || Candidates shortlisted for the interview will find the dates and selected list notified on the Departmental Notice Boards and on the official website www.meghomeguards.gov.in . Volunteers must be prepared to stay for 2–3 days at their own arrangements during the interview process. No TA/DA will be admissible for the journey or stay.

title: Technical Assistant
qualification: 3 years Diploma in Civil Engineering from recognized Institute/University with Computer Skill. Preference will be given to candidate having B.E/B.Tech in Civil Engineering with minimum one year of experience in any recognized Govt. Institute/Agencies.
salary: Technical Assistant: Rs. 22,000/- per month with other allowances as admissible.
age_limit: Maximum Age: 32 years as on 01 January 2026. || Age relaxation will be as per government rules.
application_fee: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

board: District & Sessions Judge West Jaintia Hills
title: Various Posts
qualification: Educational qualifications range from Bachelor's Degree with Diploma in Stenography to SSLC passed.
age_limit: Min: 18, Max: 32 years (relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST)

title: Fishery Officer and Junior Football Coach
qualification: For Fishery Officer: B.F.Sc. or B.Sc (Pisciculture/Fishery Science). For Junior Football Coach: Graduate in any stream with Diploma in Sports Coaching from NSNIS or equivalent, OR 10+2 with Diploma in Sports coaching from NSNIS or equivalent for medalists.
salary: Fishery Officer: Level 12 of Revised Pay Structure || Junior Football Coach: Level 11 of Revised Pay Structure
age_limit: Fishery Officer:Minimum Age: 18 years, Maximum Age: 27 years. Age relaxation applicable: SC/ST: 5 years (for certificate holders from Govt. of Meghalaya), Govt. Employee: No age bar (if entered service within prescribed age limit). || Junior Football Coach:Minimum Age: 18 years, Maximum Age: 32 years. Age relaxation applicable: SC/ST: 5 years (for certificate holders from Govt. of Meghalaya), Athlete (National Level): Up to 43 years (as per Meghalaya State Sports Policy 2019).

title: Faculty Posts (Professor/Associate Professor/Assistant Professor)
qualification: MBBS or equivalent as per IMC Act 1956, MD/MS/DM/MCh or equivalent as per speciality, Teaching/research experience as specified per post, Registration with Central/State Medical Council
salary: Level-13-A1 (Entry level pay Rs.131400/-) Plus NPA
age_limit: All Posts: As per Govt. of India rules for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD/Ex-SM.
selection_process: Screening of applications || Interview || Document Verification

title: Executive Engineer (Civil)
qualification: Bachelor Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University
salary: The selected candidate will be placed at Level 11 of the Pay Matrix.
age_limit: Maximum Age Limit: 56 years. || Age relaxation will be as per the rules of the Government of India for deputation posts.
